info.title: Pro (Trading Spot) WebSockets API
info.description:
# Introduction
Our Trading Sport WebSockets API offers real-time information and allows orders management.

The user has to subscribe to channels in order to get real-time information, and the user has to send specific commands to the WebSockets server in order to manage the orders.

Our WebSockets server provides **public channels**, with information that can subscribe any user, and **private channels**. To subscribe to the private channels the user must be logged in.

The WebSockets server URL is: **wss://ws.bit2me.com/v1/trading**

Users using the API have a [rate limit](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) of messages per second associated with a connection and command.

# Authenticate
If the user wants to subscribe to private channels or the user wants to send commands to manage orders, then the user must be authenticated.

To authenticate, the user will need a token and to get this token the user will need an API KEY.

These are the steps that the user should follow in order to [authenticate](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/blob/main/node/auth/ws.js):
1. The user needs to generate a new API Key from yout [Bit2Me account](https://account.bit2me.com/api-keys).
2. The user needs a token. To get the token the user should call [GET websocket token endpoint](/trading-spot-rest#tag/WsAuth/operation/signInApiKey).

  ```
  curl --location --request POST 'https://gateway.bit2me.com/v1/signin/apikey' \
  -H 'Content-type: application/json'
  -H 'X-API-KEY: <api key>'
  -H 'api-signature: <sign message>'
  -H 'x-nonce: <nonce>'
  ```

This token is valid only for 1 minute. So, once the user gets the token, the user must authenticate in our WebSockets server in a minute.

3. The user has to send the following command to our WebSockets server to login:

  ```
  {
      "event":"authenticate",
      "token":"the-token"
  }
  ```


If the user has been authenticated then the server will response with this message:

  ```
  {
      "event":"authenticate"
  }
  ```

If there is an error authenticating the user then the server will response with the error ocurred. Example:

  ```
  {
      "event": "authenticate",
      "error": "jwt expired"
  }
  ```


[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

# Public channels
The user can subscribe to these channels and it isn't necessary that the user had authenticated.
## Subscription order-book
The user can subscribe to the order book Level 2 sending the following message to our WebSockets server:

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/public/get-order-book)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"order-book"}
  }
  ```


**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "order-book",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
          "bids": [
              [
                  0.012,
                  4800
              ],
              [
                  0.011,
                  6000
              ],
              [
                  0.01,
                  1000
              ],
              [
                  0.009,
                  3000
              ]
          ],
          "asks": [
              [
                  0.014,
                  3300
              ],
              [
                  0.015,
                  1000
              ],
              [
                  0.016,
                  950
              ]
          ],
          "nonce": 1665998580905
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"order-book"}
  }
  ```


## Subscription trades
The user can subscribe to the last trades created in the system sending the following message:

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/public/get-last-trades)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"public-trades"}
  }
  ```

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "public-trades",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "side": "buy",
          "price": 0.012,
          "amount": 100,
          "timestamp": 1673599321725
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"public-trades"}
  }
  ```


# Private channels
The user must be authenticated in order to subscribe to the following channels.
## Subscription my-trades
The user can subscribe to this channel to get the new trades executed, optionally filtered by symbol. The user has to send this message to subscribe to this channel.

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/get-my-trades)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-trades"}
  }
  ```

  Optionally you can subscribe only to the events of a symbol.

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-trades"}
  }
  ```


**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "my-trades",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "id": "9adb20ae-f673-49a4-b232-75442e3af617",
          "userId": "7bd4cc22-7682-4e45-85b3-29386b979d75",
          "timestamp": 1665997927993,
          "datetime": "2022-10-17T09:12:07.993Z",
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
          "order": "69d3df53-9248-430c-9850-d72ff1f0befa",
          "side": "sell",
          "price": 0.014,
          "amount": 100,
          "cost": 1.4,
          "fee": {
              "cost": 0.00224,
              "currency": "EUR",
              "rate": 0.16
          },
          "isMaker": true,
          "clientOrderId": "MY-CLIENT-ORDER-ID"
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-trades"}
  }
  ```

  If you were only subscribed to events with a single symbol, you must unsubscribe by indicating the symbol.

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-trades"}
  }
  ```


## Subscription my-orders
The user can subscribe to this channel to get new messages when orders has changed, optionally filtered by symbol. The user has to send this message to subscribe to this channel.

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/get-my-orders)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-orders"}
  }
  ```

  Optionally you can subscribe only to the events of a symbol.


  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-orders"}
  }
  ```

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "my-orders",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "id": "51002851-2f76-4c10-9b4c-bcc131f27b1d",
          "userId": "7bd4cc22-7682-4e45-85b3-29386b979d75",
          "timestamp": 1666006194005,
          "datetime": "2022-10-17T11:29:54.005Z",
          "side": "buy",
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",

          "cancelationReason": "The buy price can not be greater or equal than the best ask price",
          "feeAmount": 23.324123,
          "feeCurrency": "B2M"
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-orders"}
  }
  ```

  If you were only subscribed to events with a single symbol, you must unsubscribe by indicating the symbol.

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "symbol":"B2M/EUR",
      "subscription":{"name":"my-orders"}
  }
  ```

## Subscription executions

 The user can subscribe to this channel to get new messages when trades created in the system or orders has changed.
 This channel allows you to receive events from the two channels [my-trades](#section/Private-channels/Subscription-my-trades)
 and [my-orders](#section/Private-channels/Subscription-my-orders) with a single subscription.
 The user has to send this message to subscribe to this channel.


[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/get-executions)

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",

  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",

  ```


## Subscription my-balance
The user can subscribe to this channel to get new messages when the balance of any of her/his currencies has changed. The user has to send this message to subscribe to this channel.

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/get-my-balance)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "subscription": { "name": "my-balance" }
  }
  ```

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "my-balance",
      "data": {
          "userId": "7bd4cc22-7682-4e45-85b3-29386b979d75",
          "balance": [
              {
                  "currency": "B2M",
                  "balance": 1000,
                  "blockedBalance": 1000
              },
              {
                  "currency": "EUR",
                  "balance": 100,
                  "blockedBalance": 200
              }
          ]
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "subscription": { "name": "my-balance" }
  }
  ```


## Subscription my-working-capital
The user can subscribe to this channel to get new messages when any of her/his working capital limits has changed. The user has to send this message to subscribe to this channel.

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/get-my-working-capital)

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event":"subscribe",
      "subscription": { "name": "my-working-capital" }
  }
  ```

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "my-working-capital",
      "data": {
          "userId": "7bd4cc22-7682-4e45-85b3-29386b979d75",
          "workingCapital": [
              {
                  "currency": "B2M",
                  "type": "deposit",
                  "limit": 5000,
                  "used": 2500,
                  "remaining": 2500,
                  "refillThreshold": 2500
              }
          ]
      }
  }
  ```

**Unsubscribe**

  ```
  {
      "event":"unsubscribe",
      "subscription": { "name": "my-working-capital" }
  }
  ```


# Private commands
The user must be authenticated in order send these commands the WebSockets server.

## Add order
This command allows the user to create new orders.

[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

[See code sample](https://github.com/bit2me-devs/trading-spot-samples/tree/main/node/ws/private/add-order).

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event": "add-order",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "side": "buy",
      "type": "limit",
      "price": "0.001",
      "stopPrice": "0",
      "amount": "1000",
      "clientOrderId": "c4022a5f-cfb3-46ff-9136-2739e34dd4e6"
  }
  ```

  - **side**: *buy* | *sell*
  - **type**: *market* | *limit* | *stop-limit*
  - **price** is only required for *limit* and  *stop-limit* orders
  - **stopPrice** is only required for *stop-limit* orders
  - **clientOrderId** is optional
  - **postOnly** is optional: *true* | *false*
  - **timeInForce** is optional: *GTC* | *IOC* | *FOK*
  - **amountInQuote** is optional: *true* | *false*

  [See params details](/trading-spot-rest#tag/Trading/paths/~1v1~1trading~1order/post)

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "added-order",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "id": "7d925e12-b12d-4bd9-aca3-963fb75eed93",
          "userId": "7bd4cc22-7682-4e45-85b3-29386b979d75",
          "side": "buy",
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
          "price": 0,
          "orderAmount": 100,
          "filledAmount": 0,
          "status": "open",
          "orderType": "market",
          "cost": 0,
          "createdAt": "2022-10-18T09:39:14.382Z",
          "updatedAt": "2022-10-18T09:39:14.382Z",
          "stopPrice": 0,
          "postOnly": null,
          "timeInForce": "GTC",
          "feeAmount": 0,
          "feeCurrency": null
      }
  ```

**Error response**

  [See error codes](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/Errors) to handle errors.

  ```
  {
    "event":"added-order",
    "symbol": "B2M/EUR"
    "error": {
      "code": "PRICE_LOWER_MARKET_MIN",
      "minPrice": 0.001,
      "message": "The price can not be lower than 0.001"
    }
  }
  ```


## Add orders (in batch)
This command allows the user to create multiple orders in batch. You can create a maximum of 20 orders.

[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event": "add-orders",
      "orders": [
      {
          "side": "buy",
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
          "price": "0.001",
          "stopPrice": "0",
          "amount": "1000",
          "type": "limit",
          "clientOrderId": "c4022a5f-cfb3-46ff-9136-2739e34dd4e6"
      },
      {
          "side": "sell",
          "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
          "price": "0.5",
          "stopPrice": "0",
          "amount": "1000",
          "type": "limit",
          "clientOrderId": "90b4731e-5dba-4ef5-81f1-a22dcfd6c9ac"
      }
      ]
  }
  ```

  - **side**: *buy* | *sell*
  - **type**: *market* | *limit* | *stop-limit*
  - **price** is only required for *limit* and  *stop-limit* orders
  - **stopPrice** is only required for *stop-limit* orders
  - **clientOrderId** is optional
  - **postOnly** is optional: *true* | *false*
  - **timeInForce** is optional: *GTC* | *IOC* | *FOK*
  - **amountInQuote** is optional: *true* | *false*

  [See params details](/trading-spot-rest#tag/Trading/paths/~1v1~1trading~1order/post)

## Cancel order
This command allows the user cancel one of her/his orders.

[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event": "cancel-order",
      "orderId": "order-id"
  }
  ```

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "canceled-order",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "orderId": "73352609-a885-4dc6-99c4-8a03e5df6bda",
          "status": "cancelled"
      }
  }
  ```

**Error response**

  [See error codes](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/Errors) to handle errors.

  ```
  {
    "event": "canceled-order",
    "orderId": "73352609-a885-4dc6-99c4-8a03e5df6bda",

      "code": "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
      "message": "The order with ID 73352609-a885-4dc6-99c4-8a03e5df6bda was not found"
    }
  }
  ```

## Cancel all orders
This command allows the user cancel all of her/his orders. Also, the user can send the optional parameter **side**, so the user could cancel all her *buy* orders or all of her *sell* orders.

[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event": "cancel-all-orders",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "side": "buy"
  }
  ```

  - **side**: *buy* | *sell*

**Response**

  ```
  {
      "event": "canceled-all-orders",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "data": {
          "userId":"2bf436fc-43e6-459a-b647-6b446f72ad96",
          "cancelledOrders": [
              "c5dfb28b-a306-4682-acdd-1271a299ca6b"
          ]
      }
  }
  ```

## Auto cancel orders on disconnection (kill switch)
This commands allows the user cancel all her/his open orders when there is a websocket disconnection.

[See rate limits](/#tag/Pro-(Trading-Spot)/WebSockets-API) for this command.

**Example of use:** An user send this command with a timeout of 5 (seconds). If the websockets server does not receive another **auto-cancel-orders-on-disconnection** command in less than 5 seconds then the system will cancel all the user open orders that have been created in the timeframe specified by the property **deleteLast**.

**Request**

  ```
  {
      "event": "auto-cancel-orders-on-disconnection",
      "symbol": "B2M/EUR",
      "timeout": 5,
      "deleteLast": {
      "value": 10,
      "unit": "m"
      }
  }

  ```

  - **timeout** must by specified in seconds. If its value is zero or less than zero then the auto cancel is disabled.
  - **deleteLast** is optional and is used to specify the orders that are going to be deleted based on the specified time.
  - **deleteLast.unit** can be **s** for seconds, **m** for minutes, **h** for hours or **d** for days.
